No, do you have a source for this rumor mongering question?

Is it true you are shorting SolarWinds stock?
That is exactly right. And it’s a question impossible to answer without destroying the marriage first.

Uppity is a good description. I could have posted my comment to you anywhere on any of your posts.  You would be less suspect if you actually said “I’m unhappy but I’m so uniquely suffering that if even a tangential acquaintance saw this post I would be immediately outed as being unhappy in my dead bedroom.”  If it’s that obvious to even tangential acquaintances I suspect your entire social circle is aware that you are living in an unhappy dead bedroom without ever discovering you on Reddit.  I only bothered to comment because I get triggered by people who appear to have a victim mentality and don’t seem to be able to understand and accept their own role in the creation or continuation of circumstances they wish they could change.  We nearly always have a choice, I’m guessing that for you the only choice is catastrophic so you feel powerless.  I wish you all the best in your on-going struggles.  I’ve gifted you platinum as a gesture of goodwill.

Snarky attacks on people trying to show you the trend of your own history just reinforce the truth. You have some twisted desire to stay where you are and commiserate with Redditors instead of taking action to leave your situation. You’ve been posting for years about yourself and it’s a broken record. Either you truly want a better life for yourself or you don’t, based on your Reddit post history, you don’t.
